\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 218-221 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R226-first-pass-words-from-chapters-218-221}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for parking and people.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item although, such as, so that, then, that is
  \item fake, alive, dead, deserted, local
  \item equal, main, terrible, excellent, previous
  \item private, national, international, urban, regular
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Although? (\textbf{\bn{যদিও}}, \emph{jôdio}.) Such as? (\textbf{\bn{যেমন}}, \emph{jæmôn}.) So that? (\textbf{\bn{যাতে}}, \emph{jāte}.) Then? (\textbf{\bn{তাহলে}}, \emph{tāhôle}.) That is? (\textbf{\bn{মানে}}, \emph{māne}.) Fake? (\textbf{\bn{নকল}}, \emph{nôkôl}.) Alive? (\textbf{\bn{জীবন্ত}}, \emph{jībôntô}.) Dead? (\textbf{\bn{মৃত}}, \emph{mritô}.) Deserted? (\textbf{\bn{ফাঁকা}}, \emph{phā̃kā}.) Local? (\textbf{\bn{স্থানীয়}}, \emph{sthānīyô}.) Equal? (\textbf{\bn{সমান}}, \emph{sômān}.) Main? (\textbf{\bn{প্রধান}}, \emph{prôdhān}.) Terrible? (\textbf{\bn{ভয়ংকর}}, \emph{bhôyôngkôr}.) Excellent? (\textbf{\bn{দুর্দান্ত}}, \emph{durdāntô}.) Previous? (\textbf{\bn{আগের}}, \emph{āger}.) Private? (\textbf{\bn{বেসরকারি}}, \emph{besôrkāri}.) National? (\textbf{\bn{জাতীয়}}, \emph{jātīyô}.) International? (\textbf{\bn{আন্তর্জাতিক}}, \emph{āntôrjātik}.) Urban? (\textbf{\bn{শহুরে}}, \emph{shôhure}.) Regular? (\textbf{\bn{নিয়মিত}}, \emph{niyômitô}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 222-226 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R226-second-pass-words-from-chapters-222-226}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a light bulb and a television.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a light bulb, a television, a remote control, a laptop, a printer
  \item a bangle, food, a vegetable curry, a prawn, hilsa
  \item a salad, an animal, a leopard, a fox, a wolf
  \item a team, a player, a film; a cinema, a play, a poem
  \item a traffic jam, a penalty, a licence, parking, people
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A light bulb? (\textbf{\bn{বাল্ব}}, \emph{bālb}.) A television? (\textbf{\bn{টিভি}}, \emph{ṭibhi}.) A remote control? (\textbf{\bn{রিমোট}}, \emph{rimoṭ}.) A laptop? (\textbf{\bn{ল্যাপটপ}}, \emph{læpṭôp}.) A printer? (\textbf{\bn{প্রিন্টার}}, \emph{prinṭār}.) A bangle? (\textbf{\bn{চুড়ি}}, \emph{chuṛi}.) Food? (\textbf{\bn{খাবার}}, \emph{khābār}.) A vegetable curry? (\textbf{\bn{তরকারি}}, \emph{tôrkāri}.) A prawn? (\textbf{\bn{চিংড়ি}}, \emph{chingṛi}.) Hilsa? (\textbf{\bn{ইলিশ}}, \emph{ilish}.) A salad? (\textbf{\bn{সালাদ}}, \emph{sālād}.) An animal? (\textbf{\bn{জন্তু}}, \emph{jôntu}.) A leopard? (\textbf{\bn{চিতা}}, \emph{chitā}.) A fox? (\textbf{\bn{শেয়াল}}, \emph{sheyāl}.) A wolf? (\textbf{\bn{নেকড়ে}}, \emph{nekṛe}.) A team? (\textbf{\bn{দল}}, \emph{dôl}.) A player? (\textbf{\bn{খেলোয়াড়}}, \emph{kheloyāṛ}.) A film; a cinema? (\textbf{\bn{সিনেমা}}, \emph{sinemā}.) A play? (\textbf{\bn{নাটক}}, \emph{nāṭôk}.) A poem? (\textbf{\bn{কবিতা}}, \emph{kôbitā}.) A traffic jam? (\textbf{\bn{যানজট}}, \emph{jānjôṭ}.) A penalty? (\textbf{\bn{জরিমানা}}, \emph{jôrimānā}.) A licence? (\textbf{\bn{লাইসেন্স}}, \emph{lāisens}.) Parking? (\textbf{\bn{পার্কিং}}, \emph{pārking}.) People? (\textbf{\bn{লোকজন}}, \emph{lokjôn}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
